mapper.sql: ea.achievement_id as "achievementId", ea.achievement_type as "achievementType", ea.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", ea.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ea.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", ea.achievement_occurred_on as "achievementOccurredOn", ea.certification_status as "certificationStatus", (ea.deleted_yn = 'Y') as "deleted", ea.achievement_detail_json::text as "details"
mapper.select: select from education_achievements ea order by ea.achievement_occurred_on desc, ea.achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select from education_achievements ea where ea.achievement_id = #{achievementId}

insert into education_achievements (achievement_type, teacher_user_id, evaluation_year, management_item_code, achievement_occurred_on, achievement_detail_json, certification_status, created_by, updated_by) values (upper(#{request.achievementType}), #{teacherUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.achievementOccurredOn}, cast(#{detailsJson} as jsonb), 'DRAFT', #{teacherUserId}, #{teacherUserId}) returning achievement_id as "achievementId", achievement_type as "achievementType", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", achievement_occurred_on as "achievementOccurredOn", certification_status as "certificationStatus", false as "deleted", achievement_detail_json::text as "details"
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_attachments (achievement_id, file_token, sort_order) values (#{achievementId}, #{fileToken}, #{sortOrder})

insert into graduate_degree_completion_students (achievement_id, degree_type_code, student_name, thesis_title, degree_awarded_on, sort_order) values (#{achievementId}, #{student.degreeTypeCode}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.thesisTitle}, #{student.degreeAwardedOn}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select file_token from education_achievement_attachments where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by sort_order

select degree_completion_student_id as "degreeCompletionStudentId", achievement_id as "achievementId", degree_type_code as "degreeTypeCode", student_name as "studentName", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", degree_awarded_on as "degreeAwardedOn", sort_order as "sortOrder" from graduate_degree_completion_students where achievement_id=#{achievementId} order by sort_order
mapper.update: update education_achievements set certification_status=#{nextStatus}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=current_timestamp where achievement_id=#{achievementId} and certification_status=#{expectedStatus} and deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, processed_by, reason_code, opinion, request_id) values (#{achievementId},#{previousStatus},#{nextStatus},#{actionType},#{processedBy},#{reasonCode},#{opinion},#{requestId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from education_achievements where teacher_user_id=#{teacherUserId} and management_item_code=#{managementItemCode} and achievement_occurred_on=#{occurredOn} and deleted_yn='N'
mapper.insert: insert into excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id,upload_id,row_number,row_payload,validation_status) values (concat(#{uploadId},'-',#{rowNumber}),#{uploadId},#{rowNumber},to_jsonb(#{payload}::text),case when #{status}='VALID' then 'NORMAL' else 'ERROR' end)
